title: Biological Immune System Analogy for Adversarial Fine-Tuning Defense

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If alignment 'immune memory' exists, repeated exposure-recovery could build robust alignment. Interesting hypothesis but speculative — there is no a priori reason to expect neural network training dynamics to exhibit immune-memory-like behavior.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Each fine-tuning step is mechanically accessible. However, the full experiment requires four sequential fine-tuning runs (misalign, recover, misalign again, recover again) with careful measurement at each stage. Medium compute can handle a 7B model.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four sequential fine-tuning runs with evaluation between each is time-consuming. The comparison of first vs second misalignment/recovery trajectories requires careful design. Likely exceeds 30 hours.
